name: Nimble
description:
Your base Speed is doubled, but you start each turn with no actions by default. You may convert movement into actions at a rate of 10 ft per half action, spending as much movement as you like in this way each turn.

Additionally, your jump distance and height are doubled, you can run up vertical surfaces up to 1/4 your speed as if it were flat ground, and you take no damage from falling up to 1/4 your speed if all your limbs are free.

Describe your agility.

improvements.name: Hard To Pin Down
improvements.description: You may also convert movement into engagement dice at a rate of 1d4 per 10 ft.

improvements.name: Ready To Spring
improvements.description: You may spend half your movement to assume a ready position. If you do, for the next round, each time a creature makes a melee attack against you, skip Engagement and instead roll Dexterity vs Dexterity, treating the outcome as if it were the outcome of an Engagement.

improvements.name: Like The Wind
improvements.description: Your base Speed is tripled instead of doubled.
